brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called for his corruption trial to be terminated, Al Jazeera English reported, as three judges suggested the case could be dropped. The remarks came as Netanyahu faces charges of bribery, fraud and breach of trust—allegations he has repeatedly denied.

The judicial recommendation to potentially dismiss the case arrives as Israel's longest-serving prime minister fights to consolidate power while defending himself against criminal charges that have shadowed his political career for years.
dek: The judges' recommendations came as Israel's longest-serving prime minister fights for his political survival.
title: Netanyahu demands end to corruption trial as court hints at dismissal
